sections.content: Guidelines related to occupational considerations in patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM).
Discusses pregnancy management in women with HCM, including anticoagulation use and outcomes.
Guidelines for managing HCM in patients with additional comorbidities such as obesity and obstructive sleep apnea.
Methods to improve diagnostic accuracy in HCM, including cardiovascular magnetic resonance imaging.

sections.section: 10.2 Developing Therapies to Attenuate or Prevent Disease Progression
sections.content: Therapeutic strategies to manage and potentially improve outcomes for patients diagnosed with HCM.
Care improvements for nonobstructive forms of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
